facts.fact: 大门刚被丈夫们用过却已反锁——Alex 枪击门框踹开。
facts.anchor: but it was locked suddenly—even though Grant Walker and the others had only just used it.

facts.fact: Megan（7 岁）被带子锁房——Gallagher 家同款 strap 机关。
facts.anchor: the same strap mechanism that had been used at the Gallaghers’ house in play here

facts.fact: 枪打断带救出 Megan——断带甩面划破她脸颊。
facts.anchor: the severed strap licked against her cheek and sliced into the skin.

facts.fact: Laura 不在屋——女孩是诱饵；Whitaker 从后门溜走。
facts.anchor: used her as a decoy to get anyone who was coming inside to rescue her

facts.fact: 雨刷下又一张白纸——知道是谁、怕内容。
facts.anchor: the flapping piece of white paper tucked under her windshield wiper.
